description: This is a Java test source file for testing recovery behavior of the ConnectionPersistenceActor in the Eclipse Ditto project. It contains unit tests that verify recovery of persisted connection events, handling of deleted connections, and blocked hosts configuration. It also includes inner classes for mocking persistence actors and recovering actors for testing purposes.

classes.name: ConnectionPersistenceActorRecoveryTest
classes.description: A test class that verifies recovery scenarios for the ConnectionPersistenceActor, including recovery without snapshot, with blocked hosts, and state consistency.

classes.name: RecoverActor
classes.description: An inner actor class used in testing to verify the proper recovery of persisted events by comparing expected events with those received during recovery.

classes.name: FakePersistenceActor
classes.description: A mock persistence actor used to supply predefined events to simulate recovery scenarios during testing.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initial setup for the test suite, including actor system creation and configuration.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Clean-up method to shut down the actor system after tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes common test variables before each test.

methods.name: testRecoveryOfDeletedConnectionsWithoutSnapshot
methods.description: Tests recovery when a connection was deleted without a saved snapshot, ensuring correct termination of the actor.

methods.name: testRecoveryOfConnectionWithBlockedHost
methods.description: Tests recovery behavior when a blocked host is configured, expecting an exception for invalid connection setup.

methods.name: setLifecycleDeleted
methods.description: Helper method to set the lifecycle of a connection to DELETED.

methods.name: getSnapshotOffer
methods.description: Utility method to create a SnapshotOffer object for testing snapshot recovery.
